what: Instrumented replays of five plate-stick (3900896) failures. Scratch copy of the engine with counters only (no behaviour change): pressed-contact steps and grazing steps in stuck_pair_root, overall and for the failing stuck-free pair (indices from E0022's replays), and predictions of that pair that took either step. Replayed from the start in the referee's chunking, then one event at a time from a chunk before the failure, logging the pair's surface gap after every event involving either sphere. Case 1 logged every row (decimated copy kept: every 1000th row and the last 10000; columns t, type, i, partner, gap_after, SK_I, SK_J, pressed_watch, graze_watch, pred_watch_special, pressed_all, graze_all, vz_I, vz_J); cases 2-5 aggregate gap changes by whether the preceding prediction of the pair took a pressed step. Every replay reproduces its run's failure cycle and phase (E0022). Scripts: sequel-data/runs/tools/e0026_replay_watch.py (case 1), e0026_replay_watch2.py (cases 2-5); engine patch: the four counter lines described here, applied to method/plate-stick 3900896.
mechanism: In every case the stuck (lower) and free (upper) sphere collide millions of times and never separate: after each collision the lower sphere is stuck again (captured), the relative normal speed is about zero, the pair is pressed (plate acceleration above -g), so stuck_pair_root takes two pressed steps (each to where the approach speed is 10 x STUCK_VN_MIN) and predicts the next collision 2.5e-12 later (case 1, constant). Exact arithmetic would allow about 1e-23 D of overlap per interval; observed is -1.4e-15 D per interval on average (case 1), i.e. position rounding (about one ulp of t) with a consistent sign over identical steps. Over millions of intervals this reaches the engine's -2e-8 limit. The grazing (sub-1e-12) step never fired in any run, and every pressed step in each run belonged to the failing pair.

correction_to_ledger_outcome: The E0026 outcome in ledger/experiments.jsonl says '99.9% or more' and quotes the range as -1.99978e-8 to -2.00002e-8. The correct range is -1.99779e-8 to -2.00002e-8, i.e. 99.89% (Gamma 3.5 f* 0.3 depth 15 seed 3) to 100% of the 2e-8 overlap depth. A second outcome record carrying this correction was appended and removed before commit, because program check allows one outcome per experiment. The conclusion is unchanged.
